name: Query ToDo Report
query:
SELECT

td.name as "ToDo:Link/ToDo:80",
td.description as "Subject::300",
td.reference_type as "Doctype::Doctype",
td.reference_name as "Doctype Name::Doctype Name",
td.date as "DueDate::100",
DATEDIFF(NOW(),td.date) AS "Late by Day",
td.status as "Status::80",
td.priority as "Priority::80",
td.full_name as "Allocated To::120",
td.assigned_by_full_name as "Assigned By::120"

FROM
    `tabToDo` as td
